test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some clothes are sarees.

All sarees are silks.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some clothes are silks.

II. Some silks are sarees.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ad55604b6dcff657373874380593cc6877fd7aa516925c58f0f4662c61abc49.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05b5f04b32deb9aaa1541d97e29022c28e4cb7be190ac48dfb61bbbf62a34754.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some clothes are silks - TRUE (Because some clothes are sarees and all sarees are silk, so some clothes are silk is definitely true)

II. Some silks are sarees - TRUE (Because all sarees are silk so some silk are sarees is also definitely true)

So,** both conclusion I and II follows**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
